item.title: Contratto di ricerca: fiber:loop – Development of an innovative system for the recovery of mineral fibres from construction materials through hydrothermal treatment and microbial biodegradation. (fiber:loop) ERDF 2021-2027, EFRE1136 (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-08 Microbiologia agraria, alimentare e ambientale

FIBERLoop is an industrial research project focused on the recovery and valorisation of man-made mineral fibres (MMMF), particularly glass wool and rock wool, from construction waste. The project aims to transform them into higher-value secondary materials for use as Supplementary Cementitious Materials (SCM), through mechanical pre-treatment, hydrothermal treatment, biodegradation of phenolic resins, micronisation and characterisation, followed by validation in cementitious products. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Incremento della Sostenibilità di Colture Agricole mediante tecniche di Precisione (ISCAP) (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-04 Ingegneria agraria, forestale e dei biosistemi

The research project falls within the topics of innovation for the sustainability of agricultural production, with particular reference to plant protection in Mediterranean tree crops (e.g., citrus and olive). The objective is to develop and integrate advanced knowledge and technologies aimed at reducing the use of plant protection products, through precision agriculture approaches. The expected results concern the development of solutions and guidelines for a more efficient and targeted distribution of inputs, with direct impacts on the environmental, economic, and social sustainability of agricultural enterprises. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Assessing and modeling ecosystem carbon and water fluxes in apple orchards (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-04 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-03 Scienze e tecnologie dei sistemi arborei e forestali

The research project focuses on carbon, water, and energy fluxes between the soil–plant system and the atmosphere in apple orchards. Activities will include collecting meteorological and flux data using an eddy covariance station, assessing data quality for processing, generating indicators such as NEP, GPP, NECB, and ET, and developing predictive models in the context of climate change. The contractor will also be expected to perform routine and extraordinary maintenance of the eddy covariance system, ensure remote data transmission, and relocate the system to other sites for short measurement campaigns. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Biological soil crusts as sentinels of ecosystem health and function in central and Mediterranean Europe (CrustHealth) (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-19 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-06 Genetica, chimica e pedologia agraria e forestale

The CrustHealth project investigates the role of biological soil crusts as indicators of soil health and functioning across different European climatic contexts. The research will analyze how abiotic stressors such as salinity, microplastics, and trampling affect the biodiversity, structure, and functions of communities associated with biocrusts. Field surveys, physicochemical soil analyses, controlled experiments, DNA metabarcoding, metatranscriptomics, and bioinformatic analyses will be integrated. The aim is to understand the effects of these stressors on soil fertility, stability, and biodiversity, and to identify potential indicators useful for ecosystem monitoring and conservation...

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Digital Soil Map South Tyrol (DigiSoil) (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-19 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-06 Genetica, chimica e pedologia agraria e forestale

The candidate will contribute to the development of the Digital Soil Map of South Tyrol. Key responsibilities include planning and conducting field soil surveys, collecting soil samples, and preparing and analysing them in the laboratory. The work involves the assessment of physical, chemical, and, where relevant, biological soil properties. Additional tasks include data processing, analysis and documentation, as well as supporting the modelling of soil characteristics and the production of digital soil maps. The position requires close collaboration with project partners and regional authorities within an interdisciplinary research team...
